ambiguities: Norpois's domineering, pedantic manner toward Mme de Villeparisis ('ton assez désagréable d'un professeur mécontent de son élève', likened to a 'magnétiseur') could be read as a subtly satirical diminishment of Norpois himself, not only as the agent of Villeparisis's diminishment; the passage does not give this a clean, distinct polarity independent of his role already implicit in the accepted event, so it was left unscored.
